trigger_description: The currently-granted master's byte-select operand (sel_i) is anything other than 4'hF during an active request. The golden testbench uses sel_i=4'hF for literally every active transaction with no exceptions, so this is not merely statistically rare but categorically unreachable under golden traffic -- any real system exercising partial-word (byte/halfword) accesses, however, would trigger it immediately.
observable_effect: The address forwarded to the shared slave (s_addr_o) is XORed with 0x00000010 (bit 4) for that one transaction only. Every full-word (sel=F) transaction, before, during, and after any partial-word transaction, is completely unaffected -- purely combinational, no persistent/sticky state.
